This supports a reading of his return as negotiated and politically fragile rather than mandate-driven.","question_ids":[]},{"title":"Pakistan’s Shehbaz Sharif takes oath as prime minister, directs team to talk with IMF","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-03-04","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/pakistans-shehbaz-sharif-takes-oath-as-prime-minister-3322834","summary":"Sharif was sworn in on March 4 and immediately pushed his team toward IMF engagement, showing that economic stabilization was the first-order agenda of the new term.","question_ids":[]},{"title":"Pakistan: IMF reaches staff-level agreement on the second and final review of the 9-month SBA","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-03-20","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/03/19/pr2491-pakistan-imf-reaches-staff-level-agreement-second-final-review-9-month-sba","summary":"The IMF said the new government intended to continue stabilization and reform, while also warning that growth would remain modest, inflation was still well above target, and major vulnerabilities persisted.","question_ids":[]},{"title":"Pakistan: Election-day internet shutdown is a reckless attack on people’s rights","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-02-08","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/pakistan-election-day-internet-shutdown-is-a-reckless-attack-on-peoples-rights/","summary":"Amnesty condemned the election-day telecom and mobile internet shutdown as a rights violation, indicating a coercive and rights-constrained election environment around Sharif’s ascent.","question_ids":[]},{"title":"IMF Executive Board approves 37-month EFF for Pakistan; growth returned and inflation declined","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-09-27","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/09/27/pr-24343-pakistan-imf-concludes-2024-aiv-consultation-pakistan-approves-37-mo-extended-arr","summary":"The IMF credited the authorities with restoring stability: growth returned, external pressures eased, reserves doubled over the prior year, and inflation declined markedly, even as reforms remained required.","question_ids":[]},{"title":"Pakistan’s economy stabilized in FY24, but poverty still rose","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-10-10","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/10/09/-pakistan-reform-implementation-remains-critical-for-continued-economic-recovery-and-poverty-reduction-says-world-bank","summary":"The World Bank said FY24 growth recovered to 2.5% and macro conditions improved, but poverty still increased and continued reform implementation was necessary.","question_ids":[]}]}
